授業概要
無機材料としての機能性炭素材料の基礎的物性と反応性について講義する．
有機原料の炭素材への返還における反応，返還後，機能性炭素材料の機械的，熱的および化学的基礎的な物性と反応性について講義する．
In this lecture, the basic physical properties and reactivity of functional carbon materials as inorganic materials will be instructed. The lectures will contain the contents of reactions on the conversion of organic raw materials to inorganic carbon materials. Also the fundamentals of the mechanical, thermal and chemical basic physical properties and reactivity of functional carbon materials will be afforded for students.
